item.title: Wifi Deauthentication Attack Detection/Localization
item.description:
Overview #

Along with with W. Schageman, developed an intrusion detection system to detect and triangulate the source of WiFi jamming via deauthentication attacks, common in network disruptions. ESP32(s) scan for deauth/dissoc packets in promiscuous mode, relaying alerts to a Raspberry Pi server for logging and analysis. Use Flipper Zero (with WiFi module/ESP32 marauder) to simulate deauthentication attacks in a lab environment. RSSI localization done via least squares multilateration.
